source: Notion page "Project Management - Task tracker", section Tasks, as of 2026-11-13

epics.title: Groundwork
epics.description: Repo, rules, CI, ADRs and specs before the first version.

items.title: Repo scaffold
items.description: .NET 10 API + SharedKernel + tests, React/Vite frontend + tests, Docker Compose (Postgres, MinIO, Mailpit), README, ADR template.

items.title: CLAUDE.md, agents and skills
items.description: `CLAUDE.md` with project rules; `code-reviewer` and `test-writer` agents; `trk`, `verify`, `new-module` and `adr` skills.

items.title: CI on GitHub
items.description: Add `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, run the first `npm install` and commit `package-lock.json`, switch CI to `npm ci`. Done when a PR to `dev` shows green backend and frontend jobs. Until TRK-22, "green CI before merge" is a team rule, not enforced by GitHub (branch protection needs a public repo or a paid plan).

items.title: ADR-001 to ADR-005
items.description: Stack, tenancy, auth, hosting, IDs, recording what is already agreed.

items.title: Product spec for v0.1–v1.0
items.description: User stories with acceptance criteria, wireframes for board, item detail and list, plus the shortcut map.

items.title: Tech spec for v0.1–v1.0
items.description: ERD, OpenAPI draft (auth, projects, work items), `activity_event` schema with the first event types.

epics.title: v0.1 Skeleton
epics.description: Runs end to end: login (Identity + OpenIddict), org at sign-up, `org_id` + RLS.

items.title: Database and tenancy foundation
items.description: EF Core + Npgsql, migrations applied on startup in dev, tenant context sets `app.org_id` per request, RLS helper for migrations, integration test proving one org cannot read another's rows.

items.title: Remove MinIO from the local stack
items.description: Its images were deleted from Docker Hub; ADR-0006 records the removal and proposes SeaweedFS locally / Oracle Object Storage on the POC, decided with the attachments TRK.

items.title: Sign-up and login API
items.description: Identity + OpenIddict (JWT access + rotating refresh, logout), sign-up creates the org and an Owner membership, integration tests.

items.title: Sign-up and login in the web app
items.description: Routing, TanStack Query, Tailwind + shadcn/ui, client generated from OpenAPI, sign-up / login / logout pages with token refresh, component tests + Playwright e2e (sign up → log in).

items.title: Follow-ups from the TRK-8 review
items.description: `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` also accepts the session cookie, so logout ends the session even when the tab's tokens are already gone; ADR-0010 records the frontend stack and token handling.

items.title: Projects end to end
items.description: Module, API, create and list UI; introduces the activity log + outbox (`ProjectCreated`); tests.

epics.title: v0.2 Work items
epics.description: Projects with a key, work items with parent/child, fixed workflow, list, detail, activity log.

items.title: Work items end to end
items.description: 6 types, parent/child rules, per-project keys, create / edit API, list view and item detail, activity events, tests.

items.title: Parent picker
items.description: The item form's "Parent key" text field becomes a searchable dropdown of candidates (key · type · title), only of the parent types the chosen type allows, never the item itself; type and `q` (key or title) filters on `GET /projects/{id}/work-items`; keyboard and screen-reader accessible (WCAG AA); API, component and e2e tests.

items.title: Status workflow
items.description: To Do → In Progress → In Review → Done with the allowed transitions (US-10), `POST /work-items/{id}/status` (422 lists the allowed targets), `allowedTransitions` on the item, `WorkItemStatusChanged` event, status dropdown on item detail offering only allowed moves; tests.

items.title: History API
items.description: `GET /work-items/{id}/history` from the activity log, newest first, 50 per page; actor names through a public Identity contract (also gives the item its `createdBy`); tests.

items.title: History tab
items.description: History on item detail with one sentence per event (US-09 AC2), Playwright e2e (create project → item → change status → see it in history).

epics.title: v1.0 Dogfood
epics.description: Board with drag and drop, comments, assignee; Trekky tracks itself.

items.title: Board, read-only
items.description: One column per status in workflow order with counts, cards with key, type and title, Done shows the latest 20 with "Show all" (US-11 AC1, AC2); tests.

items.title: Board gaps from TRK-15
items.description: `done_at` so Done's latest 20 means last finished; "New item" on the board; "Show all" kept in the URL and the item breadcrumb returns to the board; notice when a refresh fails and keyboard-friendly retry; board read as one snapshot; tests.

items.title: Board drag between columns
items.description: Drag and drop (dnd-kit) changes status, a disallowed move snaps back with the reason, cards move with the keyboard too (US-11 AC3, AC5); e2e.

items.title: Board reorder
items.description: `rank` column, move within a column persists for everyone (US-11 AC4); no activity event for rank changes; tests.

items.title: Comments
items.description: Add and list Markdown comments on an item, oldest first with author and time, `CommentAdded` event (US-12 AC1, AC3); tests.

items.title: Edit and delete own comments
items.description: "edited" shown, with their activity events (US-12 AC2); tests.

items.title: Assignee on items
items.description: Members endpoint, assignee set or cleared on edit, shown on list, board and detail, `WorkItemAssigned` event (US-13); tests.

items.title: Dogfood switch
items.description: Move Trekky's tracking from Notion into Trekky. Needs a running instance: either un-defer TRK-9 first or run it locally.

epics.title: v1.1 Hosting and desktop app
epics.description: Hosting now: home machine + Tailscale Funnel; every hosting TRK keeps the stack ready to move to Azure Container Apps + Neon Postgres when SaaS starts. Desktop: Tauri 2, Windows only, MSI, online only, one account shared with the web app. Order: TRK-9 → TRK-21 → TRK-23 to TRK-27 → TRK-22 → TRK-28 → TRK-29.

items.title: Running on the home host
items.description: Re-scoped 2026-11-13 (was the Oracle VM; reuses the production stack from closed PR #11, branch `TRK-9-oracle-vm-deploy`): API and web Dockerfiles, production Compose on the home machine, public HTTPS through Tailscale Funnel, nightly `pg_dump` with one tested restore. Azure-ready from the start: every setting from environment variables, OpenIddict signing/encryption certificates and ASP.NET Data Protection keys kept outside the container, nothing stored on the container disk. A new ADR supersedes ADR-0004 (home host now, Azure Container Apps + Neon later).

items.title: Frontend platform layer
items.description: Login redirect and callback, token storage, API base URL from runtime config and opening external links behind small interfaces, with web implementations only; web app behaviour unchanged; unit tests.

items.title: Desktop OAuth client and CORS
items.description: Public `trekky-desktop` client registered on startup like `trekky-web` (authorization code + PKCE, refresh tokens, redirect `trekky://auth/callback`); longer refresh-token lifetime for the desktop client only (value set in the TRK); configurable CORS origins (`http://tauri.localhost`); API tests for the desktop login flow and CORS.

items.title: Tauri 2 shell
items.description: `desktop/` with `src-tauri`, loads the built web app, single instance, first-run server URL screen (default: the TRK-9 URL, changeable later), "can't reach server" screen with retry; builds an MSI locally (WebView2 offline installer included, fixed upgrade code so new versions upgrade in place); tests.

items.title: Desktop login
items.description: Sign-up and login open in the system browser and return through the `trekky://` deep link; refresh token in Windows Credential Manager so the app starts signed in; one token refresh at a time; logout revokes and clears; smoke e2e (tauri-driver) against the local stack.

items.title: Windows build in CI
items.description: A PR job builds the MSI as an artifact, a version tag drafts a GitHub release with the MSI; unsigned for now (SmartScreen warning on install); Davit adds the workflow file.

items.title: Desktop auto-update
items.description: Tauri updater with its own signing key, update feed on GitHub Releases. Needs TRK-22 (public repo).

items.title: Move to Azure Container Apps + Neon Postgres
items.description: Images on GHCR, Container Apps for API and web, migrations as a Container Apps job instead of on startup, secrets in Container Apps, data moved with `pg_dump` / restore, desktop default server URL updated, ADR records the move. Use Neon's direct (unpooled) connection unless tenancy changes first: `TenantConnectionInterceptor` sets `app.org_id` for the whole session, which a transaction-mode pooler does not keep.

epics.title: Before going public
epics.description: What has to be settled before the repo is public.

items.title: License, trademark and domain; make the repo public
items.description: ADR-0007 license, trademark and domain check, make the repo public, protect `dev` / `staging` / `main` (PR + green CI required).

epics.title: Known issues
epics.description: Problems found and left for later.

items.title: History shows only its heading after a failed first check
items.description: From TRK-14 (PR #18): on the item page's History section, if a new item's first history read returns no events and the next check fails, only the heading shows until a later check succeeds or the page is reloaded. Needs a failure in the few seconds after creating an item.
